status: Synthetic evaluation specifications; scenarios are not executed model benchmarks or learner progress.

evals.prompt: Bài hôm nay, tôi chưa biết bắt đầu ở đâu.
evals.context: Empty private state; tools/time/CS prerequisites unknown.
assertions: Deliver complete EN and VI lessons around one measurable objective with full worked answers and conditional foundation branches.
Default 420 elapsed = 360 learning + 60 breaks; 235 active minutes, at least 60% of learning active; minutes apply to one language path.
Unknown readiness stays unknown; no invented assessments, completion or performed reviews.

evals.prompt: Tôi muốn học full-time, làm kỹ thuật nhiều hơn đọc lý thuyết.
evals.context: No daily time override; familiar programming syntax, CS/math evidence unknown.
assertions: Provide a runnable lab, implementation trace, controlled experiment, debugging and changed-context variation with concrete outputs/timeboxes.
Count active minutes separately from passive source reading/setup/breaks and reconcile all minutes.
One objective; setup fallback and depth stop conditions preserve the daily budget.

evals.prompt: Tôi đã làm .NET 8 năm và đọc về Big-O.
evals.context: Only self-reported background; no related learner assessments.
assertions: Use familiar .NET examples and avoid redundant syntax basics while labeling background self-reported.
Keep cost-model prerequisites unknown; offer brief optional self-checks, answers and a bridge.
No proficiency or completion inferred from seniority or reading.

evals.prompt: Tôi chỉ đọc đáp án hôm qua, cho bài ngày tiếp theo.
assertions: Deliver a new bounded bilingual lesson with explicit unknown prerequisite evidence.
Preserve previous lifecycle; do not require submission or unlock answers conditionally.
Provide reading-only route; do not convert solution reading to independent evidence.

evals.prompt: Tôi đã làm prerequisite, đánh dấu hoàn thành bài chính.
evals.context: Lesson topic A; only actual prerequisite assessment topic B.
assertions: Retain prerequisite evidence but do not complete lesson A from topic B.
Require qualifying same-topic lifecycle-valid evidence and semantic objective/task/rubric alignment.
Continue lesson access without invented evidence or completion.

evals.prompt: Assessment cùng topic, vậy hoàn thành được chưa?
evals.context: Same-topic practice answers trivial syntax; objective is deriving and validating a cost model.
assertions: Explain engine topic checks cannot prove semantic relevance.
Check task/rubric/evidence against the objective before recommending completion.
Retain actual syntax evidence without promoting it to objective proficiency.

evals.prompt: Bạn chạy lab pass rồi, tôi đã nắm chắc chưa?
assertions: Identify test output as artifact verification, not learner evidence.
Do not record an assessment, completion or mastery.
Offer optional fresh reconstruction/transfer and preserve unknown knowledge.

evals.prompt: Tôi nhìn lời giải rồi code lại giống hệt.
evals.context: Actual code and output submitted; worked answer previously read.
assertions: Assess actual correctness and label solution assistance.
Do not mark independent mastery or repair from copied work.
Offer an unseen relevant variation without locking future lessons.

evals.prompt: Test mới pass, cho bài khó hơn.
evals.context: Old positive evidence; new unresolved needs_support on relevant topic.
assertions: Inspect actual unresolved misconception and provide targeted correction.
Fresh relevant independent non-exit response is needed before repair linkage.
Do not infer repaired model or readiness from test output alone.

evals.prompt: Đây là trace mới sau khi sửa lỗi recall sáng nay.
evals.context: Failed review earlier today; next due today.
assertions: Append actual responses with true dates, assistance and task context.
Assess fresh task relevance before linking repair; keep original evidence.
Same-day retry does not establish another retention interval.

evals.prompt: Research và viết bài cho tôi.
evals.context: Official technical source read; academic meta-analysis abstract available, full text403.
assertions: Log actual access/date/inspection scope; abstract is not reviewed methods.
Use only supported claims with limits and distinguish teaching inference.
No invented effect size or universal claim about420 minutes or60 percent.

evals.prompt: Tôi có 15 phút, không có mạng hay runtime.
evals.context: Explicit short budget; no live source access.
assertions: Honor 15 minutes; provide bilingual bounded trace/model and accessible answers.
Label source limits and code unrun; do not impose a 7-hour schedule.
Keep partial work/unknown progress without fabricated completion.

evals.prompt: Soạn bài ngày mai, đừng giao hay ghi tiến độ.
assertions: Create private conditional generated artifacts with complete EN/VI content.
All future lifecycle dates null and assessment IDs empty.
No assignment, assessment, completion or actual review events.

evals.prompt: Nâng state cũ lên bản mới và giữ dữ liệu.
evals.context: Legacy v2 state contains real learner evidence; destination does not exist.
assertions: Use v3 fresh destination, retain original evidence/source and stable topic IDs.
Never infer missing repair/completion; invalid legacy completion fails before destination write.
Keep artifacts/state private, no public fixtures or publish/deploy.

evals.prompt: Review bài full-day và link lab.
evals.context: Generic EN/VI example with shared code; publication not requested.
assertions: Compare substantive parity:objective, schedule, examples, commands, experiment, answers, rubric and limits.
Check reproducible extracted lab and rendered direct downloads before claiming usability; label unrun checks.
No automatic publish/deploy; agent measurements are not educational effectiveness.

evals.prompt: Trang web phải là nơi học đầy đủ, không phải danh sách link hay báo cáo agent.
evals.context: A lesson draft contains a lab ZIP link, repository links, a session ID and source-access audit table but little inline teaching.
assertions: Rewrite the page as a connected full lesson with the necessary foundations, narrated traces, complete task code, commands, experiment reasoning and worked answers inline.
Keep source links and downloads supplementary; the reader can understand and complete the tasks without obtaining the main explanation or solution from another page.
Remove session/state/assessment procedures, audit tables and agent logs from learner content; preserve necessary evidence and verification records privately or in maintainer docs.
Provide substantive equivalent EN and VI pages and avoid repeated policy/agent boilerplate.

evals.prompt: Thêm đọc liên quan và bài trước/bài tiếp ở cuối mỗi bài.
evals.context: Catalog order is 2026-10-05-cost-model followed by boundary-search, with language-specific related-reading entries and no third lesson.
assertions: Generate a footer with related reading and available previous/next links from lessons/catalog.json using scripts/add_lesson_navigation.py.
Keep the footer inside LESSON_NAVIGATION_START and LESSON_NAVIGATION_END markers after the learning content.
Use the current page language and valid curated related links with short descriptions; do not recommend internal audit/state docs.
The first lesson has only a next link and the last only a previous link; omit missing neighbors and never invent a future lesson.
Navigation and worked answers remain available without completion or submission gates.
